name: megascenes-graffiti
description: Turn a word or a name into graffiti art in the lettering style you pick, on a wall, a train or a clean background.

interface.longDescription:
Type a word, a name or a short phrase and pick the lettering: wildstyle, bubble letters, 3D block letters, throw-ups or tags. Choose where it is painted, a brick wall, a subway train or a plain background, and the colors.

ChatGPT tells you what the artwork needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The graffiti opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For wallpapers, posters, gifts, team names and social posts.

Limitations: your words are passed to the model as written and the lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result; one image per run. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Paint a word or a name as graffiti
Pick the lettering style, surface and colors
Return the artwork in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make graffiti of the name MAYA in bubble letters
Paint DREAM BIG in wildstyle on a brick wall
Create a neon 3D graffiti tag of my name, Leo

positive.prompt: Which models can make graffiti art here?
positive.expected_behavior: The graffiti models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make graffiti of the words DREAM BIG in wildstyle. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one artwork with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for readable graffiti lettering?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for lettering. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make graffiti of the words DREAM BIG in bubble letters on a brick wall. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my graffiti art on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my graffiti art to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
